name: smartious-mobile
description: Smartious for iOS and Android: a Capacitor shell around the live portal.

scripts.add:android: cap add android && npm run native:android
scripts.add:ios: cap add ios && npm run native:ios
scripts.native:android: capacitor-assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor "#FBF6EC" --splashBackgroundColor "#7D1025" --splashBackgroundColorDark "#7D1025" && node scripts/patch-native.mjs android && cap sync android
scripts.native:ios: capacitor-assets generate --ios --iconBackgroundColor "#FBF6EC" --splashBackgroundColor "#7D1025" --splashBackgroundColorDark "#7D1025" && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios && cap sync ios
